ns2:course.label: Preserving Info Resources
ns2:course.description: Covers the broad range of library preservation and conservation for book and nonbook materials relating these efforts to the total library environment; emphasizes how the preservation of collections affects collection management and development, technical services, access to materials and service to users.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Lib & Inf Sci Online-UIUC.
